date: "2025-01-15"
categories: [meta]
---

This site collects my research, commentary, and policy work on international
trade — organised by theme rather than by publication type. Six hubs anchor
it:

**[Brexit](/brexit/index.qmd)** — what leaving the EU actually did to
British trade, measured rather than argued.

**[Trade Wars](/trade-wars/index.qmd)** — tariffs, export controls, and
economic coercion as geopolitics rewrites the trade map.

**[Ukraine](/ukraine/index.qmd)** — exports, reconstruction, and whether an
economy can win a war.

**[Firms](/firms/index.qmd)** — what trade policy and trade shocks do at
the level of the firm.

**[Other](/other/index.qmd)** — earlier and adjacent work on institutions,
urban economics, and spatial econometrics.

**[Consultancy](/consultancy/index.qmd)** — the policy advisory work that
runs alongside the academic research.

Posts here will track new papers, data findings, and commentary as they
happen, each tagged into the relevant theme so the hub pages stay current.
The RSS feed (top right) is the best way to follow along.
